title: iis-deploy-kit configuration
description: Single configuration file for iis-deploy-kit (ASP.NET Core API + SPA + PostgreSQL on Windows Server with IIS). Contains NO secrets: it is packaged and copied to the server.

hostName.description: Lower-case DNS host name without scheme, port or path.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the folder that contains deploy.config.json.

kitVersion.description: Kit version this file was written for. The major version must match the scripts' version.

appName.description: Short application name. Drives the server folder (C:\<appName>), IIS site/pool names, the event log source, firewall rules, scheduled tasks and the package file name.

web.description: Canonical web host, e.g. example.com. Every other host of the web site redirects here.

webAliases.description: Extra web hosts bound to the web site and permanently redirected to the canonical host, e.g. www.example.com.

eventLogSource.description: Windows Event Log source of the API. Default: '<appName> API'.

keepReleases.description: Releases (and packages) kept per component. The active and the previous release are always kept.

maxRequestBodyMb.description: IIS request size limit of the API (requestLimits/maxAllowedContentLength).

backupTime.description: Daily backup time (server local time, HH:mm).

alwaysRunning.description: API pool keeps running without traffic (AlwaysRunning, idle timeout 0, no periodic recycling, no overlapping recycle, preload). Required for background workers/hosted services.

role.description: Login role that owns the database (NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE).

majorVersion.description: PostgreSQL major version (17+: the database is created with the builtin C.UTF-8 locale provider).

installerVersion.description: EDB Windows installer version, e.g. 18.6-2. Must start with majorVersion.

installerSha256.description: Strongly recommended. Without it only the Authenticode signature is checked.

version.description: ASP.NET Core Hosting Bundle version, e.g. 10.0.12.

url.description: Optional. When url/sha512 are omitted they are read from Microsoft's official release metadata (releases.json).
x64 zip from the official GitHub releases (wacs.exe is not Authenticode-signed; the pinned hash is the check).

assemblyName.description: Main assembly (without .dll). Default: project file name.

healthPath.description: Anonymous endpoint that returns 200 when the API (and its database) is healthy.

connectionStringKey.description: Key of the database connection string in app.env (used by backups, restores and migrations).

requiredEnvKeys.description: Keys that must be present and non-empty in app.env (the connection string key is always required).

minLengthEnvKeys.description: Minimum value length per key, e.g. { "Jwt__SigningKey": 32 }. Checked only when the key is present.

envTemplate.description: Your app.env template, relative to this file. Default: the kit's templates/app.env.example.

excludeFromPackage.description: Files or folders (relative to the publish output) removed before packaging.

enabled.description: Build an EF Core migrations bundle and run it during install-release.

project.description: Project that contains the migrations. Default: api.project.

connectionEnvVar.description: Optional extra environment variable that receives the connection string while the bundle runs (e.g. read by your IDesignTimeDbContextFactory). All app.env values are always passed as process environment variables.

path.description: Frontend folder (package.json), relative to this file.

installCommand.description: Run through cmd.exe in the frontend folder. Empty string = skip.

outputDir.description: Build output folder, relative to the frontend folder.

apiBaseUrlEnvVar.description: Environment variable that receives https://<domains.api> during the build.

verifyApiUrlInBundle.description: Fail the build when the API URL is not found in the built JavaScript.

spaCheckPath.description: A client-side route that is NOT a file; after install it must return index.html (SPA fallback works).

storageArchiveDay.description: Weekday on which the daily backup also zips the storage folder.
